title: Change the world. One word at a time.
slide_intent: Test a typeface in meaningful language because rhythm and line breaks shape how a promise is heard.
strategic_value: Duolingo’s mission can acquire a consistent typographic voice through the broad rounded forms of this four-line statement.
demonstration: Large white lettering forms four lines on green; faint horizontal guides expose line alignment and letter heights.
practical_value: Evaluate the custom face at headline scale using a complete phrase and visible line structure.

content_islands.name: Headline
content_islands.spec: Stack the statement in four left-aligned lines on green.

content_islands.name: Construction guides
content_islands.spec: Retain the faint horizontal guides crossing the headline.

reference_purposes.Expression: The white statement demonstrates headline rhythm, rounded forms and generous letter width.
